title: Peridodecahedral
summary: PERIDODECAHE'DRAL, adjective [Gr.] Designating a crystal whose primitive form is a four sided prism, and in its secondary form is converted into a prism of twelve sides.

inlines.v: PERIDODECAHE'DRAL, adjective [Gr.] Designating a crystal whose primitive form is a four sided prism, and in its secondary form is converted into a prism of twelve sides.
